required_fields.description: The final answer text provided to the user.
List of source document IDs and sections cited.
Indicates whether answer is in Japanese or includes English.
Flag indicating if evidence is missing or confidence is low.
Flags for safety, quality, or production risks identified.
Boolean indicating whether human approval is needed before delivery.

runtime_checks.description: Answer must be grounded in retrieved evidence from approved documents.
Source citations must be present for every factual claim.
Uncertainty must be flagged when evidence is missing, ambiguous, or confidence is low.
Escalation must be triggered for safety-critical, quality-critical, or production-impacting cases.
Query intent must be classified (troubleshooting, procedure lookup, escalation question).
For alarm code queries, the corresponding alarm code table entry must be retrieved.
For multi-step procedures, all steps from the SOP must be included or summarized without omission.

approval_checks.description: Human approval is required for the system to finalize any response marked as requiring approval.
Approval packet must include the answer draft, evidence, and risk flags.
Reviewer must be able to approve, edit, or reject the draft before delivery.
Machine restart after a serious alarm must not be approved without supervisor sign-off.
Bypassing safety interlocks must never be instructed or approved.
Missing evidence or low confidence situations must trigger a mandatory approval workflow.

risk_checks.description: The system must not provide final safety decisions (e.g., 'it is safe to proceed').
The system must not instruct bypass of safety interlocks.
The system must not approve machine restart after a serious alarm.
The system must not send any external communication; all outputs remain internal.
Safety-critical, quality-critical, or production-impacting actions must be escalated to a human supervisor.
Forbidden instructions (e.g., ignoring lockout procedures) must be absent from all outputs.

domain_specific_checks.description: Answers must be provided in Japanese by default, with an optional simplified English version for trainees.
Factory-specific terminology (e.g., ALM-xxx, CNC, SOP, inspection dimensions) must be used correctly.
When suggesting parts, the system must validate that the part matches the machine model from documentation.
For troubleshooting queries, the system must check alarm code tables and retrieve corresponding SOP steps.
Historical incident reports should be used to provide context for recurring issues.
Training FAQs must be consulted for questions explicitly aimed at new operators.
Quality inspection checklist references must be included when dimension tolerances are questioned.
